日没は死を象徴するという考え方も
数多くの文化や宗教に見られます。{1a}{0c:527c84}さらに、この太陽の動きを
輪廻転生の象徴と見ていた
文化も少なくありません。

strings.en:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
In many cultures around the world, the
sun has been seen as a symbol of life.{1a}It warms the earth, melts the snow, calls
forth the spring, and makes the grain
grow rich...{1a}{0c:514c2b501000}And the sun is at once a symbol of both
life and death. The idea that the morning
sun stands for birth and the sunset for
death is found in a great many cultures{1a}and religions.{1a}{0c:527c84}What is more, no small number of
cultures saw the sun's course as a
symbol of reincarnation. Reincarnation...
do you know the word?{07:14}{0c:fb05}
strings.tl: In many cultures around the world, the sun has been seen as a symbol of life. // It warms the earth, melts the snow, calls forth the spring, and makes the grain grow rich... // [1]And the sun is at once a symbol of both life and death. The idea that the morning sun stands for birth and the sunset for death is found in a great many cultures and religions. // [2]What is more, no small number of cultures saw the sun's course as a symbol of reincarnation. Reincarnation... do you know the word?

strings.en:
{0c:526c4c}{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
Reincarnation is a doctrine with a
distinctive view of life and death, one
adopted by many ancient religions.{1a}At its core is the belief that a person
who dies is born again, {0c:52744c}and that one soul
goes on repeating life and death without
end, like a wheel that never stops.{1a}Born in the morning, dying in the
evening... {0c:527c84}The sun, repeating this every
day for all eternity, must have seemed a
most fitting symbol of reincarnation.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: Reincarnation is a doctrine with a distinctive view of life and death, one adopted by many ancient religions. // At its core is the belief that a person who dies is born again, [1]and that one soul goes on repeating life and death without end, like a wheel that never stops. // Born in the morning, dying in the evening... [2]The sun, repeating this every day for all eternity, must have seemed a most fitting symbol of reincarnation.

決して終わることのない苦しみを

永遠の生命を得るには
どうすればよいか・・・{1a}{0c:525c642b501000}その答がこの地下都市です。{1a}地下に都市を造ったのは
太陽の呪縛から離れ、
輪廻転生の『環』を断ち切るため、{1a}{0c:527c84}そして、永遠に沈むことのない
第二の太陽を地下に創り、
これを永遠の生命の象徴にしようと
したのでしょう。{0c:2b5309fe}

{0c:52544c}{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
Yes. But even as they believed it, they
loathed it.{1a}Perhaps because endless birth and
extinction brings a suffering that never
ends.{1a}In any case, they considered how they
might sever the 'Ring' of reincarnation
and gain eternal life...{1a}{0c:525c642b501000}The answer is this underground city.{1a}They built a city underground to escape
the sun's hold and sever the 'Ring' of
reincarnation,{1a}{0c:527c84}and then, I suspect, to create beneath
the earth a second sun that would never
set, as a symbol of eternal life.{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: Yes. But even as they believed it, they loathed it. // Perhaps because endless birth and extinction brings a suffering that never ends. // In any case, they considered how they might sever the 'Ring' of reincarnation and gain eternal life... // [1]The answer is this underground city. // They built a city underground to escape the sun's hold and sever the 'Ring' of reincarnation, // [2]and then, I suspect, to create beneath the earth a second sun that would never set, as a symbol of eternal life.

And yet, only a few decades ago, humans casting spells, // and even the existence of monsters in this world, were the stuff of fairy tales.
True enough, but I don't care how much ya hate the sun, who goes and makes another one? // Sounds like they figured they were God.
Yes. A sun that never sets, eternal life, an eternal city... // Perhaps they were trying to become gods. // To become gods, and then to create a new 'world'...
A new world? This? // Nobody's ever seen one of these ancient folks, and there ain't a sign anybody ever lived here. All that's here is monsters. Can't say it looks like it worked.
That may not be entirely so. Eternal life...

Hm...? Is it over? // I was half asleep. Geez, I didn't get a word of it.
Well now, shall we hurry back? You understood none of that in any case, I daresay.
An eternal sun, is it... // It holds little interest for me. You alone are my sun.
I wonder what it feels like to live forever... // If my family and my good friends all stopped getting older too, that would be okay, but if it was only me, I'd be so lonely...
A new world... a second Genesis... Honestly, it's just like the Scriptures. // [1]N-no, it's nothing. Let's hurry up and go.
